item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs rtsod pa zlog pa'i tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen po'i phyag bzhes tshogs gnyis rin chen gter gyi sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig ces bya ba 'di nyid dpal gshen bstan rin chen gling gi dge rgen (rgan) tshul khrims nyi ma nas rab dkar lha rdzas dri med kyis mtshams sbyar nas bskul pa dang/ nye bar hor drug cu'i phur dgon 'o ma tshal du dus gso'i zhabs brtan ched dmigs kyi ngos nas gsas mkhar spyi spungs rin chen 'di yi tshogs sgrub chen mo lo nar rgyun 'dzug grub zin pa'i skabs su bstan 'dzin drang srong mtshungs bral blo gros nyi ma sogs bla grwa rnams nas bris gzhi'i shog bu dang bcas yang nan bskul ngor ma ldog pa/ dus kyi dge byed ming 'dzin thos bsam gyi cha 'phra ba'i spa rigs rnal 'byor g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags bsod nams dpal bzang po 'bod pa des rgyal ba mnyam med chen po'i phyag len gzhir bzhag gsas mkhar rin chen spyi spungs kyi g.yung drung gsang ba'i rgyud chen drug gi dgongs don dang 'brel zhing / sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan dri med snying po'i skye srid rim pas mkha' spyod tshogs gral nas gzigs snang shar ba'i phyag len rnam par dag pa'i/ zur rgyan ting 'dzin dang tshig bshad sogs la 'khyal tshig gis bsre slad med par bka' lung dri ma med pa rnams nas btus te/ dpal gshen bstan g.yung drung rab brtan gi (gyi) bla brang dbu rtse zil gnon rab gsal khang du dkar po zhes pa sa sbrul lor tha mal pa'i las rlung phyed bcas so gnyis rgyu ba'i rjes su d+hu tir ye shes kyi rlung rags pas re reg rgyu ba'i cha lhag bsags pas phyi ru tshes zla bshol bar song ba'i khrum zla phyi ma'i dmar phyogs bzang po dang po'i nyin par res gza' rta bdun can gyi rgyur dbyu gur brtse ba'i bdud rtsi thun mtshams su sug bris bgyis pas/ dge des bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che nub maid srid mtha'i bar du gnas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
